name: Streetwear Label (Bold)
tagline: A loud, drop-driven storefront for a graphic-streetwear label.
description: A complete, working shop for a bold graphic-streetwear label: heavyweight graphic tees, 400gsm fleece hoodies and crews, a sherpa coaches jacket, utility cargos and sweats, plus caps, a tote and a beanie — each sized XS–XXL in a loud palette, with categories, collections, a bespoke drop-forward PDP and a merchandised home page. Cool concrete ground, near-black ink, one electric cardinal red carrying the brand — heavy grotesk, big caps, drop culture. Shipped as Cardinal Supply.
